Observation.org is a worldwide platform of naturalists , citizen scientists , and biologists to collect, validate and share biodiversity observations. Observation.org may be accessed via its website or from its mobile applications like ObsIdentify or Observation. [ 1 ] By 2026, the database has grown to include over 314 million nature observations of 145,595 species, supported by 138 million photos contributed by 584,000 users. [ 2 ] It is published and hosted in the Netherlands under Dutch and European law by the non-profit foundation Observation International. [ 1 ]
